name: check-base
cmd: bash research/track-m/prepare-vendors.sh && bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null && bun run check && bun test core/count*.test.ts core/count-recovery/*.test.ts && bunx commitlint --default-config < replays/commit-message.txt

name: check-candidate
cmd: bash research/track-m/prepare-vendors.sh && bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null && LAB_DISPOSABLE=1 bun research/track-m/member-premises-variant.ts flags && bun run check && bun test core/count*.test.ts core/count-recovery/*.test.ts
